title: Owlbear Egg

sources.title: Eggbearer
markers: | effects = * Carries an owlbear's egg. Its scent will attract the egg's mother.

sources.title: Steal a Githyanki Egg
markers: | description = Steal a Githyanki Egg is a Quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Lady Esther at the Mountain Pass.

summary: Provides 40 Camp Supplies or can substitute for a githyanki egg in Lady Esther’s quest.

fields.Eggbearer: Picking it up in the Owlbear Nest attracts the mother. Approaching the egg or cub may turn them hostile. In Honour Mode the mother can summon her mate.
fields.Quest use: Offer it to Lady Esther as an alternative in Steal a Githyanki Egg. The dialogue offers DC 21 Nature, Deception or Persuasion. Convincing her to fool her employers with Persuasion earns 485 gp.
fields.Camp Supplies: 40 supplies can cover a full Explorer or Balanced rest. It can be consumed by auto-selected camp supplies or fed to the Owlbear Cub.
fields.Base value: 750 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
